parameters.content: Requires the Execute Command node to be available in your self-hosted n8n instance. Configure NOTION_AUTOMATION_LOG_DB_ID before activating. The Notion Trigger node is intentionally left mostly unconfigured so you can point it at the projects database in the UI.

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: $env.NOTION_AUTOMATION_LOG_DB_ID }, properties: { timestamp: { date: { start: $json.startedAt } }, name: { title: [{ text: { content: `${$json.workflowName} pending` } }] }, details: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: 'Projects sync started by ' + $json.sourceTrigger } }] }, status: { select: { name: 'pending' } }, workflow: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.workflowName } }] }, 'execution id': { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.executionId } }] }, 'source trigger': { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.sourceTrigger } }] }, 'projects count': { number: 0 } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { details: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.details || 'Projects sync finished' } }] }, status: { select: { name: $json.status || 'success' } }, 'projects count': { number: $json.projectsCount || 0 }, 'failed node': $json.errors?.length ? { rich_text: [{ text: { content: 'Sync Projects' } }] } : { rich_text: [] } } }) }}
